text: And so the writer of this psalm is one of the people who's dragged away. He's by the rivers of Babylon, and he sat down and he wept. He wept, and the weeping, surely had some internal disappointment, frustration with himself and his people that we had abandoned God. God kept his promise, and so the weeping was some self reflection of I've I've fallen, we've fallen.
